g.text: Simultaneous reactions add their stoichiometric contributions to every species balance
Parallel one-to-one reactions and no B/C in the feed. Extent rates have mol/s units. Conversion measures A consumed; yield uses maximum B from initial
limiting A; selectivity compares desired B to undesired C. Total molar flow happens to be conserved here; it need not be conserved for arbitrary
